articles.title: HYPE jumps 11% as Trump says CFTC is working to bring Hyperliquid to U.S.
articles.snippet: During a White House meeting Wednesday, President Donald Trump said CFTC Chair Mike Selig is working to bring the perpetual futures platform into the U.S. under federal rules.

articles.title: Trump pushes Congress to move on Clarity Act during White House crypto event
articles.snippet: The CEOs from companies across several tech-forward sectors met with the president in advance of this week's first Innovation Advisory Committee at the CFTC.

articles.title: Most Americans say the Trump family’s crypto investments are not ‘appropriate’: Poll
articles.snippet: A new poll showed 63% of 1,166 Americans varied sharply along partisan lines, with a majority of Republicans saying it was appropriate for Trump and his family to invest in crypto.

articles.title: HYPE jumps 20% as Trump signals legal US path for Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: HYPE reached $72 after Trump said the CFTC was pursuing compliant US access for Hyperliquid, though no formal regulatory plan has been released.

articles.title: Trump pushes for CLARITY Act passage alongside crypto leaders
articles.snippet: Donald Trump spoke from the White House on Wednesday, urging the Senate to pass a crypto market structure bill to keep the country “ahead of China.”
